1915- collection of the artist; 1985 Whitney Museum of American Art, New York (sold through the Robert Miller Gallery, Inc., New York, New York) 
(Source: Whitney Museum of American Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Whitney Mus, May 1946."Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Shown: Photo Succession Gallery, ~~1915~~ 1916?"{"1915"crossed out} Not included in 1916 exhibition. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1915. Dated 1916 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence and similarities to cat. nos. 117, 119–21. Completed in Virginia or Texas. Pictured in 1917 New York (291) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 5. O'Keeffe wrote: "I have made this drawing several times––never remembering that I made it before––and not knowing where the idea came from"(*Some Memories of Drawings* [1988], unpaginated). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
